correctness.rationale: For a connected graph the 3rd-iterate nonfixed states are exactly the successor-neighbor colorings. The 27-state normalized transfer counts every open-ladder coloring exactly three times modulo global shift. The displayed five-class table establishes the componentwise identity M^3b=4M^2b-Mb-2b, giving the recurrence for every n. Exact standalone scripts checked each of the 27 components, 597861 independent direct dynamics configurations, and a separate 81-state transfer. Finite tests support, but do not replace, the complete proof.

value.rationale: An exact recurrent-state invariant is resolved for every open width-two square-lattice strip, a minimal-dimensional geometric family supporting 3-excitation waves. The 27-state to degree-three collapse yields an unanticipated simple recurrence, a precise temporal-cycle census and exponential rarity under uniform random configurations, with growth base (3+sqrt(17))/2. No arbitrary finite cutoff or unmotivated parameter choice enters the claim.
